title: HB1615 (2020 Regular): RELATING TO FIREARMS.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (new, HRS ch. 134): It shall be unlawful for a person to possess a loaded firearm while the person is intoxicated.
SECTION 1 (new, HRS ch. 134): Any person violating this section shall be guilty of a petty misdemeanor.
SECTION 1 (new, HRS ch. 134): A person is in possession of a loaded firearm when the person has immediate physical control over a loaded firearm and the person is outside of the person's dwelling as defined in section 703-300; and
